Human observation: Town started from the Plutonium menu by hand is a playable spawn. Console-log diff: every toolkit-started load reached Initializing game and loaded the Town gump, then the client dropped the match with SV_Shutdown: hostquit and returned to the menu; menu-started matches on the same install end with EXE_MATCHENDED. The gametype settings configs exec at frontend init in both paths, and the weapon and common_zm not-found lines are identical in the playable session, so neither is the cause; root cause is open in issue #8 and no command allowlist change was made. hello-zm was not installed or seen.
